extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: hardtail mountain bike, approx. 1.9 x 0.8 x 1.1 m (L x W x H), 27.5 in wheels with 2.4 in knobby tires
extras.notes: front faces -Y; stands on both wheels, no kickstand; wheels (with brake rotor, rear with cassette) are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); mountain-bike_steering (suspension fork, stem, riser bar, grips, brake levers) has its origin on the steering axis, tilted 24 deg: rotate around (0, 0.407, 0.914) in Blender Z-up = (0, 0.914, -0.407) in glTF Y-up; mountain-bike_crank (arms, chainring, pedals) has its origin in the bottom bracket, rotate around local X; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
